name: Chaos Omen cuts Gravity Bomb's cooldown by 30 sec and its explosion by 3 sec (#1366)
contract: Chaos Omen 706063 carries three SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) effects, all with EffectSpellClassMask word1 bit 0x80000000: EffectMiscValue SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN (11) with EffectBasePoints -30001, SPELLMOD_DURATION (1) with -3001 and SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME (19) with -3001, which resolve to -30000, -3000 and -3000 with DieSides 1 and match the tooltip "Reduces the cooldown of your Gravity Bomb by $/1000;s1 sec, and its explosion occurs $/1000;s2 sec faster." Every Gravity Bomb rank (501820-501824, 801281) has SpellFamilyFlags word1 2147483648, RecoveryTime and CategoryRecoveryTime 90000, DurationIndex 32 (SpellDuration.dbc row 32 = 6000ms) and effect amplitudes of 6000, and AttributesEx3 0x100000, not IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS. Cutting duration and amplitude by the same 3000 keeps the explosion landing exactly at aura expiry. Native path only: Player::AddSpellAndCategoryCooldowns for the cooldown, Aura::CalcMaxDuration for the duration and AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic for the amplitude.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Gravity Bomb keeps its 90 sec cooldown without the talent
Gravity Bomb's cooldown drops to 60 sec with the talent
Gravity Bomb keeps its 6 sec duration without the talent
Gravity Bomb's duration drops to 3 sec with the talent
Gravity Bomb keeps its 6 sec periodic interval without the talent
Gravity Bomb's periodic interval drops to 3 sec with the talent
